name: Piramal Finance Ltd
title: Piramal Finance Ltd - 544597 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Piramal Finance Q4 FY26: Growth RoAUM rose to 2.1% (from 1.7% a year ago) with AUM up 25% and FY27 guidance of ~25% AUM growth and ~2.5% exit RoAUM; capital consumption only 50 bps in the quarter.

triggers.label: FY27 RoAUM exit ~2.5% guided
triggers.quote: we expect to exit FY27 with a return on AUM of approximately 2.5% versus the 2.1% we reported in Q4 FY26

triggers.label: Consol NIM 6.5%, up 20 bps QoQ
triggers.quote: our consolidated level NIM expanded 20 bps quarter-on-quarter to 6.5%

triggers.label: Retail disbursements up 34% YoY
triggers.quote: Disbursements in retail recovered from a moderate Q3 and were up 34% year-on-year to INR13,101 crores

triggers.label: AA+ could cut borrowing cost 50-80 bps
triggers.quote: Domestic credit rating upgrade from AA to AA+ has the potential to lower our cost of borrowing by 50 to 80 basis points

triggers.label: Wholesale repayments ~82% of Q4 disbursements
triggers.quote: In the fourth quarter, the repayments were particularly strong, amounting to almost 82% of the new disbursements

guidance.quote: We expect another year of approximately 25% growth in total AUM
We expect consol profits to also grow at approximately 50%
we expect to exit FY27 with a return on AUM of approximately 2.5%
We thus stay very much on track for our stated goal of INR1,50,000 crores by FY28

prior_guidance_check.metric: Legacy book reduction target INR3,000-3,500 crores
prior_guidance_check.quote: the Legacy book down 59% year-on-year to INR2,807 crores versus the target of reducing it to INR3,000 crores to INR3,500 crores

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY26 consol net profit INR1,300-1,500 crores
prior_guidance_check.quote: we have reported a consolidated net profit of INR1,506 crores versus the target of INR1,300 to INR1,500 crores
our Growth AUM increased by 33% year-on-year versus the 30% target
We have successfully delivered on that plan.

red_flags.label: Q4 PL net fair-value loss ~INR900 cr and INR590 cr impairment, pre-emptive provisions
red_flags.quote: the net loss on fair value changes at almost INR1,000 crores and the INR590 crores impairment that you've taken

red_flags.label: Middle East conflict exposure in MSME sectors
red_flags.quote: We had originally taken MSMEs in the F&B sector as the epicenter of potential vulnerability

red_flags.label: Q4 insurance fee reversal for associate
red_flags.quote: There was a one-time event that we had in Q4 where we reversed some fee income in aid of our associate company

evasions.quote: I will not specify an exact amount, I'll just say that there are a few hundred crores of potential kind of write-backs

evasions.topic: Specific timing of AA+ cost benefit and capital raise
evasions.quote: Let's see what we need to do. We have some other levers as well to take care of capital needs if any.
